messages:
marisol - partnerships: Quick heads-up: AcmeCloud + Vertex agreed to co-host a Marketplace Launch webinar on 2025-06-18 09:00 PT. Need: speakers list, integration demo plan, marketplace listing checklist, swag pick & ship plan, and a dry-run slot. assigning owners.

dan - marketing: Great. i'll draft the event page copy and social assets. who will provide the ACME product screenshots and short demo clip?

nina - acme-partner: i'll send 2 screenshots and a 45s demo clip by Tue. wants a 12min live demo + 8min q&a slot.

shiv - vertex: we'll show the SI integration flow for model provisioning. prefer 10m live, 5m failover clip.

marisol - partnerships: Speaker lineup idea: 09:00 host intro, 09:03 Acme keynote (Nina), 09:15 Vertex SI demo (Shiv), 09:27 Q&A. we need a backup demo in case their infra is flaky.

heidi - devrel: i'll prepare a containerized end-to-end demo we can run in our staging cloud. includes terraform to spin marketplace listing stub and an emulated provisioner.

yao - eng: On capacity: live demo will need a brief spike. recommend reserving a small Dedicated pool from 08:45-09:30 PT. can ops handle reservation?

ops-bot: Capacity reservation requested: placeholder RD-RESERVE-XXXXX. Please confirm quantity and GPU type.

leo - product: For the Marketplace listing checklist: legal T&Cs, sample pricing, SKU mapping, telemetry hooks, deployable artifact (container), icons/screenshots, and support contact. i'll make a template and share.

dan - marketing: Also need speaker headshots and 2-line bios by Thu for the registration page. nina/shiv can you upload?

nina - acme-partner: will do by Wed morning.

shiv - vertex: ok will send bios and headshots.

heidi - devrel: Dry-run schedule suggestion: Wed 2025-06-11 09:00 PT full run, plus Thu final smoke at 08:30 PT day-of. want both vendor reps on call.

marisol - partnerships: Agreed. we'll lock that. Dan — social copy draft due Fri so paid ads can run Mon.

yao - eng: technical note: Vertex's provisioner requires a k8s CRD that our staging cluster doesn't have. heidi, can you add CRD emulation to the container?

heidi - devrel: Yup, i'll add a lightweight mock CRD and controller to the demo container. will test against rdstaging-3.

leo - product: Marketplace metadata: include usage meter type (per-token vs per-minute), compatibility flags (dedicated/private), and recommended default model variants. I'll propose defaults: redwood/aligned-7b-q4 and redwood/aligned-13b-q4.

nina - acme-partner: One ask: can Redwood provide a short promo clip (15s) showing integrated provisioning? would help social posts.

dan - marketing: We can repurpose the demo clip for promo if we get a 15s highlight by Wed. heidi/yao can you prioritize?

yao - eng: We'll capture a 15s clip during dry-run. also need to confirm network egress rules for the demo artifacts.

ops-bot: Shipping checklist created: SWAG-PL-322. shipping cutoff 2025-06-09. add customs items if hardware crosses borders.

marisol - partnerships: Swag plan: co-branded notebook + sticker sheet + limited-run challenge coin. Dan — quantity estimate?

dan - marketing: suggest 250 packs for webinar + 50 VIP kits. need budget sign-off.

leo - product: We should include a 1-pager on integration steps in each kit. heidi can provide the cut-down quickstart doc.

heidi - devrel: I'll produce the quickstart and a one-page diagram.

nina - acme-partner: Logistics Q: will hardware be needed on-site? we plan to demo cloud-to-device provisioning; no physical hardware unless requested.

marisol - partnerships: Good — reduces customs risk. if any partner insists on hardware, we will require early shipping and local pickup.

shiv - vertex: Also note: SI will run a synthetic provisioner test that opens 2 concurrent channels. please confirm rate limits on demo pool.

yao - eng: i'll set demo pool limit to 3 concurrent sessions and throttle at 5 rps per session for safety. will document in runbook.

marisol - partnerships: Owner recap: Headshots/bios by Thu (Nina/Shiv), demo clip 15s + 45s by Tue (Nina/Heidi), dry-run Wed 2025-06-11 09:00 PT (All), marketplace metadata template by Leo by Fri, swag SKUs & budget by Dan by Mon, capacity reserved by Ops once confirmed. everyone good?

dan - marketing: all good :+1:

heidi - devrel: good on my side

nina - acme-partner: yes thanks, pushing assets now

shiv - vertex: ok, will be on the dry-run calls

ops-bot: Capacity reservation updated: RD-RESERVE-20250618-A100x2 (08:45-09:30 PT).

marisol - partnerships: Thanks team. i'll stitch this into the shared checklist and ping again if any blockers.
